title: Seedless 3' pairing enables miR-17 family miRNAs to seize let-7 target sites.
snippet: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are short noncoding RNAs that post-transcriptionally regulate gene expression. Their canonical function depends on a "seed" sequence at the miRNA 5' end that pairs with conserved sites in the 3' untranslated regions of target messenger RNAs to suppress gene expression.
